title: Start with the forecast
caption: How many guests are we expecting? The chef turns the forecast into a preparation plan.
question: What should we prepare?
narrative: Review expected covers, the menu and recipe requirements before deciding how much each section should prepare.

title: Draw stock for mise en place
caption: Take the ingredients from the pantry and bring them to the section, ready for preparation.
question: What does the section need?
narrative: Draw the ingredients needed for mise en place from the pantry. Keep the source and destination clear.

title: Prepare the ingredients
caption: Peel, portion and mix. The recipe guides the work as the section gets ready for service.
question: Is the preparation on track?
action: The chef follows the preparation plan
narrative: Prepare ingredients against the recipe: peel and portion the pears, prepare the filling and assemble the batch.

title: Bake, cook and get ready
caption: Preparation becomes finished food. The tray goes into the oven, ready for the next stage of the day.
question: What will be ready for service?
narrative: Begin baking or cooking and keep the section’s preparation plan up to date as food becomes ready for service.

title: Record usage and wastage
caption: Record what left the pantry, what went into the recipe, what was returned and what was wasted.
question: Where did the ingredients go?
action: The chef records usage and waste
narrative: Complete the stock record after preparation. In this illustrative batch, 3.0 kg drawn equals 2.4 kg used, 0.3 kg returned and 0.3 kg of peel waste.

title: Inspect and receive deliveries
caption: Check the order, inspect the produce and record what is accepted before it enters stock.
question: Did we receive what we ordered?
narrative: Inspect deliveries as they arrive, check quantities against the order and record the accepted stock. Follow up shortages with the supplier.

title: Keep the team in step
caption: Review the roster, confirm section cover and share the handover before service.
question: Does everyone know the plan?
action: The chef and owner review the team plan
narrative: Manage the roster through the day and share preparation updates and handovers so the team can work from the same plan.

title: Upload the day’s sales
caption: Upload sales data and compare what was sold with the morning’s forecast and preparation.
question: What actually happened today?
action: The owner uploads and reviews sales
narrative: Upload the day’s sales data. Compare actual covers and dishes sold with what was forecast and prepared, then review the differences.

title: See the whole working day
caption: For the chef, a clearer preparation plan. For the owner, stock, waste, staffing and sales to review together.
question: What will tomorrow need?
action: The chef and owner plan the next day
narrative: Bring the day’s records together to inform the next preparation plan. The illustrative pear balance is 8.0 kg opening stock, less 3.0 kg drawn, plus 0.3 kg returned and 10.0 kg received: 15.3 kg remaining.
